enchantments.tooltip: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Assassinate +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Insightful Assassinate +7: +7 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Deception +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to hit and +17 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Mantle of Suulomades: While wearing two pieces from the Mantle of Suulomades set, you gain:+30 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+15% Artifact bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
